title: Who Goes There?
description: Form Narrative Premiere Status UK Country United Kingdom Year 2020 Running Time 24min Language English, Norwegian Director Astrid Thorvaldsen Screenwriter William Gillies Producer Leah Bethany Jones Key Cast Nina Yndis, Siri Meland, Rikké Haughem, Liam McMahon Minnesota 1880: The trust of three Norwegian sisters is tested when a stranger appears on their prairie. When the eldest invites him in to heal her dying sister, she doesn’t realise that a supernatural force is crossing her threshold. In a dystopian Neo-Steampunk world, Douglas, a shy introvert, enlists the help of “A Better You”, a customisable android clone, to help him win the girl of his dreams.
